item: row 268: map marker hovers reach touch (title attribute)
summary: Every marker app-map.js draws (wiki pages and infobox addresses, mentioned places, server IPs, signals, Insights cities) carries its hover in a title attribute, never an SVG title child, so the #oo-tip bubble opens on touch long-press; gate row D's address provenance now reaches a phone. Chromium walk before/after for the page and address markers; the others run in the node test.
